text: Very Small. I can’t believe how small this is. I can barely fit a towel in it. No way could it fit a change of clothes. Also very flimsy. Waste of money.

product_metadata.title: Green Mesh Shower Caddy Tote - Portable, Quick Dry, Hanging Toiletries, Cosmetics and Bath Products Organizer - 7 Pockets -by Honey-Can-Do
features: TOILETRIES ON THE GO: A must have for college dorms, gym showers, overnight camps & all kinds of travel, these portable caddies neatly store your soap, shampoo, conditioners, toothbrush and more.
PLENTY OF SPACE: With 7 compartments - 1 large center opening and 6 side pockets - this tote accommodates many large & small items, and it is easy to spot and find what you need when you need it.
HANG ANYWHERE: The carrying handle straps double as a heavy duty hanger and "hanging hook". Hang it in the shower, on a dressing or changing room hook, or put it down flat on a bench or any surface.
QUICK DRYING FABRIC: Made of polyester mesh, our shower totes dry quickly after use.
GORGEOUS GREEN: Bring a splash of verdant spring indoors with this bright green, silver-trimmed tote to match your silver-toned bathroom hardware. The gender neutral colors suit both men & women.
description: Is your endless array of toiletries cluttering your bathroom? Or do you need a portable solution for shared shower space? Introducing this Shower Caddy Tote Bath Organizer by Honey-Can-Do; a lightweight organizer that fits all your bathing essentials.

With a total of 7 compartments, 1 large interior opening and 6 side pockets, this 9 x 8 x 6 inch tote has space for an ample supply of toiletries. Stash your shampoo & conditioner, soap & body-wash, shower gel, scrub, shaving cream & razor, toothbrush & toothpaste, you name it! No more stepping out of the shower or fumbling around your bathroom to retrieve much-needed supplies while bathing!

Do not hesitate to take this caddy into the shower with you! The polyester mesh material is quick-drying and breathable. While lightweight at merely 5 ounces, our mesh material is remarkably durable & flexible, supporting even salon & economy-sized bottles without ripping or tearing. Forget hard plastic caddies that crack & break. Honey-Can-Do’s Shower Caddy Tote Bath Organizer is a more modernized, sanitary solution.
